text_block_list.text:
At night, right after returning to the 
academy. At Biwa Hayahide's request, we 
decided to review the race footage 
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. My positioning this time seems to 
have been a bit sloppy. The drawback of 
focusing solely on what's ahead during the 
race, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please play the footage once more. It 
seems there are other points we need to 
iron out.
choice_data_list:
By the way, are you sure you don't need to 
rest?

text_block_list.text:
She has just experienced her very first 
race and concert. Fatigue must be building 
up in her body.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry. Thanks to actual 
racing, I was able to notice flaws I'd 
overlooked until now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then I will simply keep improving. After 
all, the winning formula I seek must be 
capable of standing up against her."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Every single second is precious to me.

She likely perceives the completion of 
that formula as an exceedingly difficult 
task.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Acceleration... wind resistance... and 
the leg's angle of incidence relative to 
the surface..."

First, what I should do as her Trainer 
might be to provide her with practical 
experience that helps her construct her 
theories.
choice_data_list:
...Would you like to run in the Asahi Hai 
FS?

...Why not try running in the Asahi Hai 
FS?

text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS... The 'Asahi Hai 
Futurity Stakes' is a GⅠ race that brings 
together top Junior-class Umamusume.

That makes getting results all the harder, 
but it's sure to be a great experience for 
Biwa Hayahide.

Biwa Hayahide's glasses glinted. And just 
like that, our next goal was decided.
